sql.trim: id as id, user_name as userName, itcode as itcode, type as type, phone_number as phoneNumber, mail as mail, description as description, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, status as status, password as password, delete

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_name, itcode, "type", phone_number, mail, description, "status", "password", "delete", date_range) VALUES (#{item.userName}, #{item.itcode}, #{item.type}, #{item.phoneNumber}, #{item.mail}, #{item.description}, true, #{item.password}, false, #{item.dateRange});
mapper.select:
select id , user_name , itcode, type , phone_number , mail , description , to_char(create_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC-8','YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') as create_time, to_char(create_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC-8','YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') as update_time , status , password , delete, date_range from sys_user
delete = false
and user_name like '%'||#{item.userName}||'%'
and itcode like '%'||#{item.itcode}||'%'
and type = #{item.type}
and phone_number = #{item.phoneNumber}
order by create_time desc

with tmp as (with recursive tmp as (select mr.parent_id from menu_router mr, sys_role_menu srm, sys_user_roles sur where mr.id = srm.menu_id and srm.checked = true and sur.role_id = srm.role_id and sur.user_id = #{id} union all select mr.parent_id from menu_router mr, tmp where mr.id = tmp.parent_id and mr.parent_id is not null) select parent_id from tmp) select sr.description as roleDescription, sr."name" as roleName, array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(array_agg(concat_ws('/', mr.menu_key, case when srm.read_write then 'Reading And Writing' else 'Read Only' end)))), ';') as features from menu_router mr , sys_role_menu srm , sys_user_roles sur , sys_role sr where (srm.menu_id in (select parent_id from tmp) or srm.checked = true) and mr.id = srm.menu_id and sr.id = sur.role_id and sur.role_id = srm.role_id and sur.user_id = #{id} and sr.status = true group by sr."name", sr.description
UPDATE sys_user SET "delete"= true where id = #{id} and internal = false

select
from sys_user where (itcode = #{id} OR id = #{id})

select distinct r.read_write as readAndWrite, menu.id as menuId, menu.* from (select * from menu_router) as menu left join (select srm.menu_id, srm.read_write from sys_role_menu srm left join sys_user_roles sur on srm.role_id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id = #{id}) as r on menu.id = r.menu_id order by id

select distinct su.user_name as id, su.user_name as userName, su.user_name as itcode, 'ADFS' as type, '' as phoneNumber, su.email as mail, '-' as description from ad_tb_upp_nature_2 su , sys_user_roles sur where su.user_name = sur.user_id and sur.role_id = #{roleId} and sur."type" = 'ADFS'

and atun.user_name like '%'||#{name}||'%'

select * from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and delete = false limit 1

select distinct sr."name" as roleName from sys_role sr left join sys_user_roles sur on sur.role_id = sr.id left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 atun on atun.user_name::varchar = sur.user_id where lower(atun.user_name) = lower(#{itcode}::text)
select id, user_name, mail from sys_user where mail = #{email} and status = true and delete = false

phone_number= #{item.phoneNumber},

description = #{item.description},

delete = #{item.delete},

UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET status = case when status then false else true end, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and internal = false
